g12-economics-ue2-t1.overview: Aggregate Demand sits inside Aggregate Demand and Aggregate Supply Analysis. Aggregate demand and supply are the focus of Unit 2 of Grade 12 Economics in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it builds the concept of aggregate demand, its curve, and the shifts in it. Then it does the same for aggregate supply, in both the short run and the long run. Finally, it brings the two together to find equilibrium and to trace demand and supply shocks. Students will also learn how the aggregate demand and supply model explains real-life fluctuations.
objectives: Explain the concept of aggregate demand and its curve.
Explain the concept of aggregate supply in the short and long run.
Distinguish a movement along a curve from a shift of the curve.
Show short-run and long-run equilibrium at potential output.
Use the aggregate demand and supply model to analyze fluctuations.
g12-economics-ue2-t1.simple:
Aggregate Demand in plain words. The exam wants you to recognise the core ideas, not to memorise whole paragraphs. Focus on:
  • First, the concept of aggregate demand.
  • Then the downward-sloping aggregate demand curve.
  • Also the factors that shift the curve.
g12-economics-ue2-t1.detailed:
Aggregate Demand — the essentials. First, the concept of aggregate demand. Then the downward-sloping aggregate demand curve. Also the factors that shift the curve.

What the MoE expects you to be able to do:

  • Explain the concept of aggregate demand and its curve.
  • Explain the concept of aggregate supply in the short and long run.
  • Distinguish a movement along a curve from a shift of the curve.
  • Show short-run and long-run equilibrium at potential output.
  • Use the aggregate demand and supply model to analyze fluctuations.
